labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: DOSBox Staging is a modern continuation of DOSBox a free and open-source emulator that enables the execution of MS-DOS software, especially video games.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Dosbox-staging

dockerfile.amd64:
FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:debiantrixie

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG DSTAGING_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE="DOSBox Staging" \
    SDL_VIDEO_X11_VISUALID="" \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/dosbox-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y \
    xz-utils && \
  if [ -z ${DSTAGING_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    DSTAGING_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/dosbox-staging/dosbox-staging/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/dosbox.tar.xz -L \
    "https://github.com/dosbox-staging/dosbox-staging/releases/download/${DSTAGING_VERSION}/dosbox-staging-linux-x86_64-${DSTAGING_VERSION}.tar.xz" && \
  mkdir /opt/dosbox && \
  tar xf \
    /tmp/dosbox.tar.xz -C \
    /opt/dosbox --strip-components=1 && \
  mkdir -p \
    /usr/share/icons/hicolor/128x128/apps && \
  cp \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    /usr/share/icons/hicolor/128x128/apps/dosbox.png && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001
VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
## 🛑 STOP: Read the docs BEFORE asking questions or opening issues

> [!CAUTION]
> **Most questions we receive are already answered in the documentation.**
> Questions and issue tickets that are clearly covered by the docs may be closed without further discussion.

### Before you post anything, you **MUST**:

1. 📖 **Read the [0.83.0 release notes](https://www.dosbox-staging.org/download/release-notes/0.83.0/)**. They explain what's new, what's changed, and what may behave differently from previous versions.
2. 🚀 **New to DOSBox Staging? Read the [Getting Started guide](https://www.dosbox-staging.org/getting-started/).** This is **not optional**. It covers the basics that most first-time questions are about.
3. 📚 **Check the [user manual](https://www.dosbox-staging.org/0.83/manual/introduction/about-this-manual/)** to learn how the new features work and how to configure them.
4. 🔍 **Search the [project website](https://www.dosbox-staging.org/)** using the search box in the top-right corner. It searches the *entire* site, including the Getting Started guide and the user manual.
5. 🧩 **Check the [wiki](https://github.com/dosbox-staging/dosbox-staging/wiki) and the [Game issues](https://github.com/dosbox-staging/dosbox-staging/wiki/Game-issues) page.** Your problem may already be known, and there may be a workaround.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Only ask a question or raise an issue ticket after you've done ALL of the above.**
> When you do post, tell us what you've already read and tried. It saves everyone time and gets you an answer faster.
